proves.claim: itemLine for a withdrawn item at stage landed with a merged commit prints on main at the first 12 characters of the commit, not landed.

cli.io-read.itemline-landed-names-main-s.why: Without it, builders read withdrawn (landed) as not on main and release dependents of hand-landed items as blocked.

proves.claim: itemLine for a withdrawn item with no merged commit, and for a verified item, prints the same line as before.

cli.io-read.itemline-withdrawn-unmerged-.why: Without it, the new wording could leak onto items that did not land by hand.
